name: Dehydroacetic Acid & Sodium Dehydroacetate
aliases: INS 265, INS 266, dehydroacetic acid, DHAA, sodium dehydroacetate, SDHA, sodium dehydroacetic acid
what_is: Dehydroacetic acid and its sodium salt are antimicrobial-related food substances used under specified conditions in some jurisdictions, including direct food uses listed by FDA.
why_botia: BOTIA flags the explicit names because these substances may be declared by chemical name and are not part of the ordinary EU E-number list. Regulatory permission is jurisdiction- and use-specific; a declared name does not establish the amount present.
can_1: Detect dehydroacetic acid, sodium dehydroacetate and the audit's INS 265/266 identifiers when explicitly printed.
can_2: Show that their status must be interpreted by jurisdiction rather than assuming an EU E-number authorisation.
cannot_1: Determine the concentration or whether a particular use complies with its legal maximum from the ingredient list alone.
cannot_2: Infer their presence when they are not declared.
